title: Add AI-autonomous development capability assessment and 8-week improvement roadmap
body:
Evaluated 114 protocol schemas for AI-autonomous enterprise software development readiness. Current 73% test coverage blocks workflow automation, plugin ecosystem, and external integrations.

## Assessment Results

**Test Coverage by Category:**
- ✅ Complete: API (100%), Permission (100%)
- ⚠️ Critical Gaps: Automation (43%), Hub (14%), Integration (17%), Security (0%)

**Current AI Capabilities:**
- Code generation (frontend/backend/API/tests/docs)
- CI/CD pipelines with GitHub/Vercel integration
- Production monitoring with auto-rollback
- Self-iteration framework (DevOps Agent Protocol)

**Blocking Issues:**
- No workflow orchestration (approval/ETL/sync protocols untested)
- No plugin discovery/installation (marketplace protocols untested)  
- No external SaaS integration (Salesforce/HubSpot/Stripe connectors untested)
- No compliance enforcement (encryption/GDPR/HIPAA protocols untested)

## Deliverables

Three strategic documents:

1. **AI-DEVELOPMENT-ASSESSMENT.md** - Executive summary with protocol inventory
2. **AI-AUTONOMOUS-DEVELOPMENT-PLAN.md** - 6-phase roadmap (8 weeks to 100% coverage)
3. **AI-AUTONOMOUS-DEVELOPMENT-PLAN.zh-CN.md** - Chinese translation

## Roadmap Structure

**Phase 1-3 (Critical, Weeks 1-3):** Test automation, hub, integration protocols
- Enables: AI-generated CRM apps with full deployment and external integrations
- Coverage: 43%→100% (automation), 14%→100% (hub), 17%→100% (integration)

**Phase 4 (High, Week 4):** Security & compliance protocol testing
- Enables: GDPR/HIPAA/SOC2 enforcement, field encryption, PII masking

**Phase 5-6 (Medium/Low, Weeks 5-8):** AI enhancements and new protocols
- Adds: Cost optimization, knowledge graphs, multi-modal processing, agent collaboration

## Success Criteria

- **Week 3:** AI builds complete CRM apps end-to-end with Salesforce/Stripe integration
- **Week 8:** 100% protocol coverage, full autonomous development capability

Each phase includes detailed action items, test templates, and implementation guidance.
